qa.consumerRequirement: Use mask.components as a union of convex rectangles; concave contours require a multi-polygon aware clipper.
limitations: Feet show oblique three-toe material; strict side-profile anatomy requires assembled visual review.
Open hen head is a separately generated candidate; do not switch without eye registration.
No image pixels modified; precision masks preserve connected source ownership.

integration.requires: Use hen skin for every layer; never mix rooster torso/tail. Derive source-foot support from current mask rather than legacy 8.13px.
